name: Jeppiaar Engineering College
summary: Jeppiaar Engineering College on Rajiv Gandhi Salai (OMR) was established on 15 August 2001 under the Jeppiaar Educational Trust, founded by Col. Dr. Jeppiaar. It is affiliated to Anna University, accredited 'A' by NAAC, and was granted autonomous status by the UGC in 2026.
